Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, CD8+ variant: Laboratory tests: Complete blood cell count, metabolic panel, hemoglobin A1c, viral and rheumatologic panels, and serum/urine protein electrophoresis were normal or unremarkable (F8)
Imaging studies: Chest radiograph, High-resolution chest CT scan, Hand radiographs, and Echocardiography were normal or unremarkable (F9)
Numerous pink-purple dermal papules on trunk and extremities, preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs (F6)
Skin biopsy findings: Nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, admixed atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes, low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal (F12)
T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample (F13)
Flow cytometry of bone marrow: Revealed lymphocytes with atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype (F14)
Immunostaining: Lymphocytes positive for CD3, inverted CD8:CD4 ratio, predominantly α/β positive (F15)
